test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: To raise awareness on the safe use of digital payment services and prevent scams, which of the following institution of India launched a UPI Safety Awareness Campaign ‘Main Moorkh Nahi Hoon’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) is a key organization in the sphere of retail payments and settlement systems in India.
 
• NPCI launched the UPI Safety Awareness Campaign 'Main Moorkh Nahi Hoon' to educate users about safe digital payment practices.
 
• The campaign aims to prevent frauds and scams by raising awareness about secure usage of Unified Payments Interface (UPI).
 
• NPCI plays a pivotal role in the development of innovative payment solutions like UPI, which has revolutionized digital transactions in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unified Payments Interface (UPI)**

 
 
• UPI is an instant real-time payment system developed by NPCI, facilitating inter-bank transactions.
 
• It allows users to link multiple bank accounts to a single mobile application, enabling seamless money transfers.
 
• UPI transactions are secure, leveraging two-factor authentication as mandated by RBI.
 
• The popularity of UPI has surged, making it one of the most preferred digital payment methods in India.
 
 
 
• **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**
 
 
• Established in 2008, NPCI is an umbrella organization for operating retail payments and settlement systems in India.
 
• It was founded by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
 
• NPCI's primary objective is to create robust payment and settlement infrastructure in India.
 
• Besides UPI, NPCI has developed other payment solutions like RuPay, IMPS, and BHIM.
 
 
 
• **Digital Payment Security**
 
 
• Ensuring secure digital transactions involves using strong passwords, enabling two-factor authentication, and being cautious of phishing scams.
 
• Users should regularly monitor their transaction history for any unauthorized activities.
 
• It is crucial to download payment apps from official sources and avoid sharing OTPs or PINs with anyone.
 
 
 
• **Financial Literacy**
 
 
• Financial literacy involves understanding and effectively using various financial skills, including personal financial management, budgeting, and investing.
 
• It is critical for individuals to enhance their financial knowledge to make informed decisions and avoid financial frauds.
 
• Organizations and governments often conduct awareness campaigns to improve financial literacy among the population.
